proposal.summary: The Administrator section of the Surveillance module in Global RADAR - BSA Radar 1.6.7234.24750 and lower exposes a local file inclusion via the /UC/downloadFile.ashx endpoint by manipulating the FileName (and FilePath) parameter, allowing an authenticated user with privileges to download arbitrary local files from the web server.
proposal.cwe_quote: a user is able to view local files on the web server by manipulating the FileName and FilePath parameters in the URL

AV.quote: a user is able to view local files on the web server by manipulating the FileName and FilePath parameters in the URL

PR.quote: The current user is required to have valid privileges to send requests to the target vulnerable endpoint.

C.quote: This vulnerability could be used to view local sensitive files or configuration files on the backend server.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability by reproducing the request against a test instance with an administrative account, confirm the set of accessible files, and implement input validation/whitelisting or canonicalization on FileName/FilePath to prevent path traversal. Consider patching to restrict file downloads to intended files and require server-side checks.
